scenarios.basis: Increase common communication and monitoring dependencies.
Hypothetical reliable heartbeat monitor and removal of its shared dependency.
Conditional improvement in operator detection opportunity; requires workload validation.

claims.description: A functioning heartbeat monitor prevents an undetected loss when common monitoring failure is absent
An available BLOS path prevents total link loss without shared infrastructure failure
Separate LOS and BLOS equipment faults are necessary for total undetected loss
Two monitoring software modules establish independent detection

interpretation: The top event is undetected communication loss at the ground station. It does not by itself establish uncontrolled aircraft behavior: onboard lost-link behavior is a separate unresolved interface. Shared monitoring dependency BE9 appears once even though it defeats two monitors.
basis: Authored correction of the preserved gallery hazard model. Boolean event meanings and parameter scenarios are proposed teaching abstractions, not accepted field data.
